title: Two more games join the showcase
summary:
Three community projects joined the showcase, while outdated project and tutorial links got a tidy-up.

AIStorium joined the Games list with interactive stories, images, and audio generated through Pollinations. AI Word Search joined with personalized puzzles that can be printed or shared.

Prompt Explorer was added to the Learn projects list. Its Android app combines AI art and prompt exploration with Pollinations image generation, history, and favorites.

The Open Web UI tutorial now points to the intended guide. The project showcase also dropped outdated listings, corrected the Anime Character Generator link, and updated its project tables.
